t: You are at Millwall Dock, on the Isle of Dogs, just south of Canary Wharf. It is a dock in the London Borough of Tower Hamlets. John Blacket, who died in 1832, is recorded as having commissioned and owned it. He is described as a plantation owner and London merchant. That tells you the dock was tied to the wealth of trade and plantations, though I have no further detail to offer.
